# Copilot instructions

This repository is a skill for building a Qurʾān muṣḥaf reader that matches the
printed page.

**Read [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first**, then [`../SKILL.md`](../SKILL.md)
in full. Load files from `references/` only as the task needs them. Run the
gates in `scripts/` before shipping anything.

The standing rule, because in this domain wrong data renders beautifully:
**make a wrong thing loud, never plausible.** Do not clamp a range to fit, do
not invent a missing word, do not shift an index until it looks right. Drop the
row, report it, and say what you dropped.

Do not add Qurʾānic text, layout data or typefaces to this repository. It
documents where they are and how to verify them; it redistributes none of them.
